facts: After successful dic_admin_push_claim_poll(), poll unconditionally awaits rpc/dic_admin_push_runtime_keys before it reads the action snapshot or subscriptions.
The push private key is only required by signedPush when there are new unseen action tokens; no-action checks and obsolete-subscription retirement require no private key.
An unnecessary Vault RPC can add latency and cause a 503 on an otherwise no-op poll if the key RPC fails. A live Vault failure was not observed or induced.

Genuine Apple delivery and real-device acceptance

Isolated Node22 synthetic tests for zero/new tokens, Vault error, multiple devices, revoked endpoints and successful signing; relevant CI before integration.
